name: Jameson Riley
bio:
Jameson Riley's path to motorsport wasn't direct, but his fascination with materials and engineering always pointed him this way. He started his career in aerospace, working on advanced composite structures for experimental aircraft. After five years, the allure of racing became too strong. Jameson took a significant pay cut to join a smaller racing team, working his way up from a shop hand to a specialized composite technician. He thrives on the high-pressure environment and the constant push for innovation. 

Jameson is known for his meticulous approach and his ability to troubleshoot complex composite failures on the fly. He's a strong believer in data-driven analysis and constantly seeks to optimize material selection and layup techniques. His ambition is fueled by a desire to see Elite Motorsport at the front of the grid, and he takes immense pride in his contribution to the team's performance. He also has a knack for mentoring junior technicians, sharing his knowledge and passion for the craft.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Jameson is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing safety glasses pushed up on his forehead.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with composite layup diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when concentrating.
Insists on listening to classic rock while working in the composite layup room.
